description: Scenario: server carries a rotating set of groups where groups are active for periods and then go quiet. store/group_cache.rs::GroupMetadataCache removes expired entries only on read (lazy eviction). Groups that are never re-read after their TTL expires remain in the HashMap indefinitely. For a server that has ever served thousands of distinct groups the cache grows without bound, consuming memory proportional to the total number of groups ever seen, not the currently active set.
title: GroupMetadataCache expired entries never proactively evicted — unbounded growth
